body:
## Problem

PR #394 changed the four Rust lanes (`rust-clippy`, `rust-tests`, `rust-crash`, `rust-runtime`) to gate on `always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.quick.result == 'success' && <plan output>` so a failed or skipped `lbug-prebuilt` acceleration job can never skip them into a red aggregate. That fail-open is correct, but `always()` also evaluates to true when the workflow run is cancelled.

The workflow uses `concurrency.cancel-in-progress: true`. When a superseded push cancels a run after `plan` and `quick` have finished but before the lanes started, GitHub still starts all four lanes on the cancelled run. Each one downloads nothing (the prebuilt artifact was never uploaded) and pays a full cold Ladybug source build plus its tests. Before #394 the lanes used `needs.quick.result == 'success' && ...` without `always()` and were skipped on cancel. The `rust` aggregate and `vitest` jobs already used `always()` before #394, so the same waste exists there at lower cost.

## Fix

- Replace `always()` with `!cancelled()` in the `if:` of the four lanes in `.github/workflows/ci.yml`. `!cancelled()` keeps the same fail-open semantics for a failed or skipped `lbug-prebuilt` (it is true on failure and skip, false only on cancel).
- Apply the same substitution to the `rust` aggregate and `vitest` jobs, which are pre-existing `always()` users.
- Update the exact pinned `if` strings in `test/ci-required-check.test.mjs` (the lane assertions added in #394, around the "builds the Ladybug library once" test) and any aggregate/vitest pins.
- Update the sentence in `docs/agents/ci.md` that describes the lane gates if it names `always()`.

## Verification

- `npx vitest run test/ci-required-check.test.mjs` green with the new strings.
- Hosted: push twice in quick succession on a PR touching Rust; the superseded run must show the lanes as cancelled or skipped, not running to completion.

Source: adversarial review of #394 at head `e7976648`.
title: CI: Rust lanes gate on always() and run to completion on cancelled workflow runs
